images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original opaque painted roadside travel billboard for the fictional 3D arcade racing game Pacific Rush, landscape 3:2 aspect, 1536 by 1024 composition.
Primary request: A nostalgic late-1990s coin-op racing travel illustration for a new course called SPILLWAY SPRINT. Bold readable hand-painted block lettering 'SPILLWAY SPRINT' across the upper part. No other words.
Scene: Exuberant California-inspired waterworks fantasy: huge pale concrete dam arches, bright turquoise reservoir water, layered concrete road viaducts weaving above and below each other, dramatic cascading waterfalls and sunlit rocky cliffs. A small original orange racing coupe with a cream stripe charges along a foreground road. Road guardrails and bridge supports make the layered roads convincing. The mood is fast and adventurous, with inviting bright blue sky.
Style: Original airbrush-and-gouache arcade cabinet illustration, richly painted scenic depth, chunky readable shapes, stippled/dithered shading and slightly grainy printed ink. Saturated cobalt, turquoise, warm cream concrete and coral highlights. Filled composition with no blank margins, no photographic realism.
Constraints: This is decorative fictional travel art, not a technical map or a screenshot. Entire image opaque and edge-to-edge. No existing game logos, real car brands, trademarks, UI overlays, borders, frames or watermarks. Spell SPILLWAY SPRINT exactly. Preserve readable lettering at distance.
